claims: Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle.
Israel Adesanya is a former champion.
The main card features Israel Adesanya vs. Joe Pyfer.
The main card starts at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT.
The prelims start at 5 p.m. ET/2 p.m. PT.
